title: Chairman Meow
description: Chairman Meow is your pet cat. Keep this card in front of you. It has no effect.

title: Alarm Cat
description: Keep Alarm Cat in front of you. At the start of each of your turns, draw an extra card.

args.title: Its controller draws an extra card at turn start.

human_canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.register_hook('on_turn_start', scope='player', code="def apply(state, ctx):\n    state.draw_cards('self', 1)\n", title='Its controller draws an extra card at turn start.', condition_keys=[])

title: Flea Curse
description: Choose a player and put this curse in front of them. They lose 1 point at the start of each of their turns.

args.title: Its controller loses 1 point at turn start.

human_canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.register_hook('on_turn_start', scope='player', code="def apply(state, ctx):\n    state.subtract_points('self', 1)\n", title='Its controller loses 1 point at turn start.', condition_keys=[])

title: Bottomless Water Bowl
description: This artifact stays in front of you. Whenever you play a pet, draw 1 card.

args.title: Its controller draws when they play a pet.

human_canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.set_card_attribute('this', 'kind', 'artifact')
    state.register_hook('on_play', scope='player', code="def apply(state, ctx):
    card = state.card(ctx.get('card_id') or '')
    if card and card.get('attributes', {}).get('kind') == 'pet':
        state.draw_cards('self', 1)
", title='Its controller draws when they play a pet.', condition_keys=[])

title: Closet Monster
description: Choose a player. Closet Monster stays in front of that player. At the end of their turn, they discard a random card.

args.title: Its controller discards randomly at turn end.

human_canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.register_hook('on_turn_end', scope='player', code="def apply(state, ctx):\n    state.discard_random('self', 1)\n", title='Its controller discards randomly at turn end.', condition_keys=[])

title: Mail Dog
description: Mail Dog becomes your pet and sits in front of you. When played, draw 2 cards.

title: Rescue Mission
description: Choose a pet in front of an opponent. Steal it and keep it in play in front of you.

title: The Great Pet Heist
description: Steal every opponent's pets. They remain in play, now in front of you.

human_canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.move_cards(from_zone='in_play', from_player='all_others', selector='all', to_zone='in_play', to_player='self', match_attributes={'kind': 'pet'})

title: Cat Council
description: Keep this rule in the center. At game end, whoever controls the most cats wins.

title: Top Dog Law
description: This law remains in the center. The player with the most dogs wins the game.

title: Cat Census
description: Gain 2 points for every cat in front of you, then discard this card.

title: No Pets Allowed
description: Choose any pet in front of any player and destroy it.

title: Moonlit Collar
description: This enchantment remains in front of you. At the end of your turn, gain 1 point.

args.title: Its controller gains 1 point at turn end.

human_canonical.sandbox:
def apply(state, ctx):
    state.register_hook('on_turn_end', scope='player', code="def apply(state, ctx):\n    state.add_points('self', 1)\n", title='Its controller gains 1 point at turn end.', condition_keys=[])

description: This boon stays in front of you. At the start of your turn, draw 1 card.

args.title: Its controller draws 1 card at turn start.

title: Cone of Shame
description: Choose a player and attach this curse in front of them. They lose 2 points at the end of each turn they take.

args.title: Its controller loses 2 points at turn end.

human_canonical.sandbox:

title: Zoomies
description: Keep this power-up in front of you. When you play it, take an extra turn.

title: Bandit Cat
description: Bandit Cat becomes your pet and stays in front of you. When played, steal one pet from a chosen opponent and keep it in play.

title: Emotional Support Rock
description: This rock is your pet. Place it in front of you. It does nothing, but it believes in you.
